description: The rules section (default null = none) — world-scoped rules, the SAME ActionPredicate/ActionEffect/ActionTriggerMode primitive a kit's per-body actions already use, widened one level up (see WorldRule). OPTIONAL, deliberately: a new REQUIRED section would refuse every existing document at boot for declaring nothing.

items.description: One world-scoped rule: a condition over world facts and the effects that follow — the SAME primitive a kit's per-body actions already run on (ActionPredicate, ActionEffect, ActionTriggerMode), widened to the world's own scope rather than a sibling engine with its own vocabulary. There is no scheduler and no trigger taxonomy beside this: time is just another fact.

name.description: The rule's stable name — unique within the section, the UpsertWorldRule/RemoveWorldRule key, and the world.rules read-back line. A WorldCellName, the SAME validated-identifier type a state row and a cell key ride: dot-free and free of the reserved character set, refused BY NAME (naming the offending character) at the JSON converter before a document can hold one. The reserved $ prefix is refused on top of that, by CompileAll — exactly as it is for a state ROW name, and for the same reason: $ marks what the ENGINE mints, and nothing mints a rule.

effects.description: The effects applied in order when the rule fires.

gate.description: The predicate that must hold, or null for always.

mode.description: Whether the rule fires every tick the gate holds (Level, the default) or once per crossing (Edge). A rule that writes a row almost always wants Edge: level-firing an addState is what wrote 503 journal entries in 500 ticks.
